claim: At revision adf4885a3a5d4ddb7e30e737e83e72a44ee8dec6, the long README Python example at lines 295-418 raises KeyError: 'subset' at README line 390 because WebFontOptimizerPackage.manifest does not contain the keys that only package.bundle.manifest carries.
suggested_issue_title: README web-optimizer example reads "subset", "requested_variable_mode" and "requested_stat_policy" from WebFontOptimizerPackage.manifest, which does not contain them
suggested_issue_body:
repository-presenter's validation pipeline (BC-03) recorded this while re-verifying `aspose-font-foss/Aspose.Font-FOSS-for-Python`; it was then reproduced independently against the live default-branch head `adf4885a3a5d4ddb7e30e737e83e72a44ee8dec6` on 2026-10-09T21:10Z.

## Summary

Everything in the README example before line 390 runs. Line 390 reads `subset_bundle.manifest["subset"]["coverage"]["missing_count"]`; lines 397 and 406 read `requested_variable_mode` and `requested_stat_policy` from the same manifest. Those keys exist on `package.bundle.manifest`, not on `package.manifest`.

## Environment

- Revision `adf4885a3a5d4ddb7e30e737e83e72a44ee8dec6` (default branch `main`)
- Windows 11, Python 3.13.15, `pip install .`; input `testdata/Roboto-VariableFont_wdth,wght.ttf`

## Steps to reproduce

Run the python fence at README.md lines 295-418 verbatim, or this probe:

```python
from aspose_font import FontLoader, WebFontOptimizer
font = FontLoader.open("Roboto-VariableFont_wdth,wght.ttf")
b = WebFontOptimizer.build(font, presets=("latin","arabic"), text="Aspose", include_woff=False)
print("subset" in b.manifest, "subset" in b.bundle.manifest)
l = WebFontOptimizer.build(font, include_woff=False, variable_mode="live")
print("requested_variable_mode" in l.manifest, "requested_variable_mode" in l.bundle.manifest)
```

## Actual result

```
  File "ex.py", line 95, in <module>
    print(subset_bundle.manifest["subset"]["coverage"]["missing_count"])
KeyError: 'subset'
```
The probe prints `False True` and `False True`.

## Where in the repository

- `README.md:390`, `:397`, `:406`
- `src/aspose_font/web.py:761,805` (the package manifest), `:2544-2573` (the bundle manifest that holds the keys); the library itself reads `package.bundle.manifest` at `web.py:1142`
